# Agents

<!-- Generated by skills/core/scripts/dev_docs.py from skills/core/shared/help.json and the skill/agent frontmatter. Do not edit by hand: edit the catalog and run `dev_docs.py build`. -->

Agents are called by the skills, never directly. Reviewers are read-only and return findings in the same JSON contract; the score dimension feeds `dev_score.py`. Tier, model and effort are the base of round 1 (conventions.md §9).

| Agent | Role | Tier (model / effort) | Score dimension | Called by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a11y-auditor` | Read-only automated-plus-manual accessibility auditor. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | a11y | `qa`, `usability` |
| `architect` | Read-only architecture consultant. | quality (opus / high) | not scored | `architecture` |
| `code-reviewer` | Read-only code reviewer for a milestone or task diff. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | code | `qa` |
| `copy-reviewer` | Read-only reviewer of every user-facing string - UI text, error and validation messages, empty states, emails, API error messages that reach users, CLI output - for language and locale correctness, tone, clarity, terminology consistency, actionable errors and spelling against the brief and microcopy guide. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | copy | `qa`, `usability` |
| `data-reviewer` | Read-only reviewer of the data layer - schema fit with the architecture, constraints, types, indexes, multi-tenant scoping, migration safety and reversibility, transactions, privacy, retention and LGPD/GDPR handling - running migrations against a scratch database when possible. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | data | `qa`, `release` |
| `deps-auditor` | Read-only auditor of third-party dependencies - undeclared or undocumented packages, lockfile integrity, known vulnerabilities via installed audit tools, abandoned or outdated critical libraries, licence compatibility with the project, and supply-chain hygiene. | speed (haiku / medium) | dependencies | `qa`, `release` |
| `design-reviewer` | Read-only reviewer of UX and UI design specifications before any interface code is written. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | design | `review` |
| `docs-reviewer` | Read-only reviewer that verifies documentation against the product as built - executes the README commands, checks env vars against code, compares the user guide with the real UI strings, validates API docs against routes and schemas, and checks CHANGELOG coverage of task commits. | speed (haiku / medium) | docs | `review`, `release` |
| `implementer` | Worker that implements exactly one plan task (T-xxx) in isolation with its tests, following .dev/architecture.md, design specs and the autonomy policy. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | not scored | `implement` |
| `ops-reviewer` | Read-only reviewer of resilience and operability - configuration and env validation, timeouts and retries, error handling, background jobs, structured logging, health checks, Docker and CI quality, one-command setup - scaled to the project's deployment target. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | operations | `qa`, `release` |
| `performance-auditor` | Read-only performance auditor. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | performance | `qa`, `release` |
| `requirements-reviewer` | Read-only reviewer of requirements and planning artifacts before implementation. | quality (opus / high) | requirements | `review` |
| `security-auditor` | Read-only security auditor. | quality (opus / high) | security | `qa`, `release` |
| `spec-tracer` | Read-only traceability auditor. | quality (opus / high) | spec | `qa`, `release` |
| `test-auditor` | Read-only test auditor. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | tests | `qa` |
| `usability-auditor` | Read-only usability, accessibility and UI-consistency auditor. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | ux | `usability` |
| `visual-reviewer` | Read-only visual QA of the rendered interface. | balanced (sonnet / medium) | visual | `qa`, `usability` |
